acceptance.given: A clean supported checkout with empty demo database
acceptance.when: run documented migration and seed commands twice
acceptance.then: second run changes no fixture IDs or counts; API and UI display labelled synthetic scenario and schema version

acceptance.given: No model credentials
acceptance.when: start UI/API/worker and complete manual lookup
acceptance.then: manual path remains usable; agent availability is explicitly disabled

acceptance.given: Database is unavailable or a required configuration value is malformed
acceptance.then: process liveness is separate from dependency readiness; readiness is non-success with sanitized correlation ID

acceptance.given: Reset is aimed at a database not explicitly marked disposable demo
acceptance.then: refuse without deleting records; reset requires matching environment guard and explicit demo target

acceptance.given: Repository existing Python 3.9 evaluation suite
acceptance.when: install Python 3.12 application dependencies in separate environment
acceptance.then: legacy suite remains independently runnable; app lock and setup record supported versions

acceptance.given: Assigned feedback task and case awaiting documents
acceptance.then: show recorded request, owner, source time and original due date without inventing progress

acceptance.given: No approved next update or completion estimate
acceptance.then: show next update unknown and completion date unknown separately; pending commitment is not displayed as approved

acceptance.given: Two events arrive out of order with distinct occurrence/recording times
acceptance.then: use stable aggregate sequence and show both timestamps; do not overwrite prior finding with late ingestion

acceptance.given: A case ID belongs to another customer or task has been reassigned
acceptance.then: deny with uniform FORBIDDEN_OR_NOT_FOUND; no existence disclosure and no retained stale detail

acceptance.given: Re-review and complaint intake coexist
acceptance.then: show separate owners/statuses and original case link; completion of one does not mark the other resolved

acceptance.given: Unavailable upstream or conflicting current versions
acceptance.then: show unavailable/conflict rather than no case or closed; retain last-view freshness label and disable unsafe commit

acceptance.given: A manual draft with customer allegation and supported facts
acceptance.when: staff edits and approves current proposal revision
acceptance.then: save exactly reviewed content, labelled allegations, actor/time, source versions and durable receipt

acceptance.given: Source or assignment changes after draft
acceptance.then: reject stale/unauthorized commit; preserve user edits for deliberate rebase, never silently overwrite

acceptance.given: Two edits target same proposal version
acceptance.then: one version advances, second conflicts; revision history remains auditable

acceptance.given: Same approval key/payload is retried after response loss
acceptance.then: return same committed note and receipt; no duplicate note/outbox event

acceptance.given: Same operation key with changed content
acceptance.then: IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT with original content untouched

acceptance.given: Note says refund completed but there is no completion evidence
acceptance.then: flag unsupported action claim; statement may only be stored as attributed customer allegation, not confirmed execution

acceptance.given: Model or unscoped employee invokes edit or commit
acceptance.then: deny; create_proposal remains draft-only; server authority does not come from body fields

acceptance.given: Offline fake provider and fixed tool response fixtures
acceptance.then: same domain tool schemas and server authorization run without vendor credentials

acceptance.given: Streaming provider emits partial/invalid tool arguments
acceptance.then: buffer until complete, validate schema, execute no partial/invalid call; bounded repair or safe failure

acceptance.given: Rate limit, timeout, cancellation or missing usage
acceptance.then: return typed terminal status; no duplicate operational effect; missing usage/cost stays unavailable, not zero

acceptance.given: Internal-only profile or unapproved endpoint
acceptance.then: deny unauthorized egress; never silently switch to a public provider

acceptance.given: Eligible OpenAI and Claude credentials/budget available
acceptance.then: record dated model/provider/config, tool compatibility, actual costs and failures for each; otherwise mark live qualification not executed

acceptance.given: Provider input contains customer/internal data outside allowed DTO
acceptance.then: exclude credentials/contact details/internal-only notes; safe trace preserves references not sensitive payload

acceptance.given: A live route lacks a required capability
acceptance.then: route remains unqualified; DeepSeek/internal compatibility is not inferred from API similarity

acceptance.given: A known synthetic event ledger with duplicate delivery
acceptance.then: deduplicate by authoritative IDs; exported totals equal fixture oracle and SQL source totals

acceptance.given: Completed, cancelled, failed and abandoned runs
acceptance.then: include all started runs in outcome denominator; show unresolved and missing latency explicitly

acceptance.given: Draft edited multiple times then approved once
acceptance.then: count a proposal once by defined revision/status rule; distinguish accepted unchanged from edited; exclude pending from decided-only denominator and display pending count

acceptance.given: Original contact plan followed by lead-approved plan
acceptance.then: report lifetime calls, per-plan calls, technical faults and original-window misses separately; no apparent improvement from erased history

acceptance.given: No human effort study or provider usage missing
acceptance.then: no measured savings/ROI shown; missing cost remains unavailable; synthetic status visible

acceptance.given: Same data refresh is repeated, including late events
acceptance.then: stable snapshot totals reconcile; late-event adjustment and data cutoff are recorded

acceptance.given: Current Must requirements and story AC IDs
acceptance.then: each maps to planned layer, fixture, independent oracle and release gate; missing mapping fails validation

acceptance.given: Cross-customer read or agent-approved write is attempted
acceptance.then: access is denied at API/service boundary; no secret/internal detail in response or trace

acceptance.given: Duplicate requests, stale versions and worker restart
acceptance.then: one effect/receipt, preserved audit, recoverable pending work; report actual database version

acceptance.given: A deliberately invalid transition is injected in isolated test
acceptance.then: test fails for the expected business reason; remove mutation after demonstration

acceptance.given: Live models/cloud/database are unavailable
acceptance.then: affected suites explicitly skipped with reason; schema checks never relabelled runtime/UAT pass

acceptance.given: A critical authorization/closure case fails
acceptance.then: block promotion regardless of average score or total passing-test count

acceptance.given: Clean checkout with approved locks
acceptance.then: record commit/config/image digests; no unpinned latest dependency in release artifact

acceptance.given: Any required lint/type/contract/integration check fails
acceptance.then: no release-candidate promotion; retain failure evidence

acceptance.given: No model key and private database network
acceptance.then: manual UI/API operate; database is not publicly exposed; readiness waits for schema/dependencies

acceptance.given: Browser assets, images and logs inspected
acceptance.then: no provider key, private customer material or raw datasets; env example contains placeholders only

acceptance.given: Only local checks executed, GitHub not connected
acceptance.then: state cloud CI not executed; never mark cloud build success

acceptance.given: Migrations or workers fail during staging rollout
acceptance.then: stop promotion, preserve data and pending work; restore/forward-fix plan tested in isolated staging before release
